extracted.intended_audience: little magazine and small book press editors worldwide; Pushcart contributing editors
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and submission guidelines for nominating poetry, short stories, essays, memoirs, or stand‑alone novel excerpts to the Pushcart Prize; specifies who may nominate, allowed formats/genres, deadlines, and mailing instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible nominators
rubrics_metrics.description: We welcome up to six nominations (print or online) from little magazine and small book press editors throughout the world. We also accept nominations from our staff of distinguished Contributing Editors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominations should come from editors of little magazines and small book presses or from Pushcart's Contributing Editors; nominations may be print or online.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maximum nominations per editor
rubrics_metrics.description: We welcome up to six nominations (print or online) from little magazine and small book press editors throughout the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each eligible editor may submit up to six separate nominations in total (across allowed genres/formats).

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible genres and formats
rubrics_metrics.description: The nominations may be any combination of poetry, short stories, essays, memoirs, or stand-alone excerpts from novels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pushcart accepts a wide range of literary forms; nominations may be traditional or experimental in style.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translations and reprints allowed
rubrics_metrics.description: We welcome translations, reprints and both traditional and experimental writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Works that are translations or reprints are explicitly eligible; experimental pieces are also accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication timeframe requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Nominations must have been published (or scheduled to be published) in the current calendar year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only works published in the current calendar year, or scheduled for publication in that year, are eligible for that year's Pushcart edition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission window and postmark requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Nominations are accepted between October 1 - December 1 (postmarked) for next year's Pushcart edition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions must be postmarked within the specified window (Oct 1–Dec 1) to be considered for the following year's edition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission method and mailing address
rubrics_metrics.description: We do not accept nominations via email. Mail to Pushcart Press, P.O. Box 380, Wainscott, NY 11975.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All nominations must be mailed physically (no email submissions). Contact phone provided: (631) 324-9300.

rubrics_metrics.name: Materials to send / do not send entire books or journals
rubrics_metrics.description: Please send one copy of each work. Please do not send entire books or journals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Send a single copy for each nominated piece; do not mail full issues or whole books as nominations.

rubrics_metrics.name: No returns policy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Materials submitted will not be sent back; nominators should retain originals or send copies they do not need returned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees and forms
rubrics_metrics.description: There is no entry fee and no form to fill out.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No payment or formal entry form is required—simply mail the nomination(s) per the instructions within the deadline.
